meta.name: use-native-credential-proxy
meta.description: Opt out of the OneCLI gateway and supply Anthropic credentials from .env instead. For users who want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault. Reads the API key or OAuth token from .env and injects it into the container's API requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从.env文件读取凭证并注入API请求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不想用OneCLI网关，想用简单的.env管理凭证
copy.tagline_en: Read credentials from .env and inject into API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want simple .env-based credential management without the OneCLI agent vault

howto.what: 启用后,NanoClaw 会从 .env 读取 Anthropic 的 API 密钥或订阅令牌,启动容器时直接注入环境变量,不再经过 OneCLI 网关。只有 .env 里设了 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true 才生效,否则原行为不变。
howto.when: 当你想用 .env 管理 Anthropic 凭据、不用 OneCLI 网关时启用。运行前需设 NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true,并在 .env 填 API 密钥或订阅令牌,再重启服务。

say.text: 我想用 .env 管理 Anthropic 凭据,不走 OneCLI 网关
say.note: 会安装原生凭据代理并注入容器环境变量。

say.text: 用 .env 里的 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 做认证
say.note: 会写入 .env 并重启服务生效。

say.text: 改用 Claude 订阅令牌认证

howto.what_en: Enabled: NanoClaw reads Anthropic credentials from .env and injects them into the container env at startup instead of the OneCLI gateway. Only active with NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true; otherwise no change.
howto.when_en: Activated when you ask for .env-based credentials instead of OneCLI. Runtime trigger: .env has NANOCLAW_NATIVE_CREDENTIALS=true and one of the supported credential keys, then the service is restarted.

say_en.text: I want to manage Anthropic credentials from .env, not via the OneCLI gateway.
say_en.note: Installs the native credential proxy and injects them into the container env.

say_en.text: Switch the credential source to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from .env.
say_en.note: Writes it to .env and restarts the service.

say_en.text: Use my Claude subscription token for auth.
say_en.note: Asks you to run `claude setup-token` first.
